data.description: A vibrant freehold community in Jebel Ali, offering modern residences, premium amenities, and excellent connectivity to key destinations across Dubai.

data.answer: Wasl Gate offers residents a vibrant lifestyle enriched by a variety of amenities. The community features lush green parks, state-of-the-art fitness centers, and a diverse selection of dining and retail outlets. With its modern infrastructure and well-planned spaces, Wasl Gate ensures a high standard of living for its residents.

The property landscape in Wasl Gate is diverse, featuring studio, one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as three and four-bedroom villas. These residences are designed to cater to various family sizes and lifestyle preferences, offering modern amenities and contemporary designs.

Popular Buildings in Wasl Gate

Gardenia Townhomes - Gardenia Townhomes offers spacious three and four-bedroom townhouses, designed for families seeking a harmonious blend of comfort and style. Residents enjoy access to amenities such as gyms, parks, and recreational facilities, fostering an active lifestyle.

Gardenia Townhomes II - Building upon the success of its predecessor, Gardenia Townhomes II presents elegantly designed three and four-bedroom villas. The community features a clubhouse equipped with a swimming pool and gym, providing residents with premium leisure options.

The Nook - The Nook comprises contemporary apartments ranging from one to three bedrooms, catering to young professionals and small families. The development boasts modern interiors and offers amenities such as a swimming pool, fitness center, and landscaped gardens.

Off-Plan Projects in Wasl Gate

Hillside Residences, developed by Wasl Properties, is an upcoming freehold project within Wasl Gate. It offers a selection of one to four-bedroom apartments, duplexes, penthouses, and sky villas. Amenities include lush green spaces, fitness centers, and recreational facilities. The payment plan features a 5% down payment, 35% during construction, and 60% upon handover, with completion anticipated in Q3 2027.

Renting a Property in Wasl Gate

Prospective tenants in Wasl Gate can choose from studio to three-bedroom apartments, as well as three and four-bedroom villas. Additionally, commercial spaces such as shops are available for rent, catering to various business needs. This diverse range of properties makes Wasl Gate a sought-after destination for those seeking properties for rent in Dubai.

Buying a Property in Wasl Gate

For those interested in ownership, Wasl Gate offers studio to three-bedroom apartments, three and four-bedroom villas, and retail shops for sale. The community also features off-plan properties, including one to four-bedroom apartments, providing ample opportunities for investors and homeowners looking for properties for sale in Dubai.

more_info.question: What’s Life Like in Wasl Gate?

data.answer:
Living in Wasl Gate means enjoying a strategic location in Jebel Ali, with seamless connectivity via Sheikh Zayed Road. The community is designed to offer residents a balanced lifestyle, featuring landscaped parks, modern fitness centers, and a variety of dining and retail options. Proximity to Festival Plaza Mall enhances the shopping experience, while well-planned infrastructure ensures convenience in daily activities. The blend of residential and commercial spaces fosters a vibrant and inclusive community atmosphere.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Wasl Gate

Wasl Gate's strategic location along Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) ensures excellent connectivity to the rest of Dubai, facilitating easy commutes to major business and leisure hubs. Energy Metro Station is located nearby, offering convenient public transport options. Residents also benefit from private parking facilities, enhancing convenience for those with personal vehicles.

Supermarkets in Wasl Gate

Residents have convenient access to Geant Express, a well-stocked supermarket within the community, ensuring daily shopping needs are easily met.

Shopping Malls in Wasl Gate

Festival Plaza Mall, located within Wasl Gate, offers over 120 retail outlets and 40 eateries, providing a comprehensive shopping and dining experience. The mall also features entertainment options, including Battle Park, making it a family-friendly destination.

Schools and Nurseries near Wasl Gate

Jebel Ali Primary School, located just 3 minutes from Wasl Gate, follows the British curriculum and caters to students from Foundation Stage to Year 6. It is known for its high academic standards and strong extracurricular programs.
Ghaf Private School, approximately 4 minutes away, offers the American curriculum for students from Kindergarten to Grade 12. The school provides a well-rounded education with a focus on academic excellence and character development.

The Winchester School, situated 5 minutes from Wasl Gate, follows the British curriculum from Foundation Stage to Year 13. It is a reputable institution offering a strong academic program with an emphasis on student development and global learning.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Wasl Gate Location

Residents of Wasl Gate have access to several mosques in the vicinity, including Jebel Ali Mosque and Al Furjan Mosque, both within a 10-minute drive. These mosques provide daily prayers, Friday sermons, and community services.

For Hindu residents, the Shiva Temple and Sai Baba Temple in Jumeirah are about a 25-minute drive from Wasl Gate. These temples serve as important spiritual centers, offering religious ceremonies and cultural gatherings.

Christian worshippers can visit St. Francis of Assisi Catholic Church and Christ Church Jebel Ali, both located within 10 minutes from the community. These churches hold regular mass services and provide community engagement programs.

The Guru Nanak Darbar Sikh Temple, one of the largest Sikh gurdwaras in the region, is within a 5-minute drive from Wasl Gate. It serves as a place of worship, social service, and community gathering for the Sikh community in Dubai.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Wasl Gate

Residents have access to quality healthcare facilities, including Mediclinic Ibn Battuta, which is about a 10-minute drive away, and NMC Royal Hospital in Dubai Investments Park (DIP), approximately 15 minutes from the community. Both facilities provide general and specialized medical services, ensuring convenient healthcare options for residents.

Wasl Gate Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Wasl Gate is well-connected to some of Dubai’s most vibrant neighborhoods, including Al Furjan, Al Muntazah, Discovery Gardens, and The Gardens. These areas offer additional lifestyle and entertainment options, complementing the residential experience of Wasl Gate.

more_info.question: Things to Do in Wasl Gate

data.answer:
Wasl Gate offers a dynamic lifestyle with access to green parks, fitness centers, and a variety of retail and dining experiences. Residents can enjoy outdoor recreational areas or visit nearby entertainment destinations for leisure and relaxation.

Wasl Gate Restaurants

Dining options in Wasl Gate include Nando’s, serving flame-grilled peri-peri chicken, IKEA Restaurant, known for its Swedish-inspired menu, and Sapori, which offers authentic Italian cuisine. These restaurants cater to diverse tastes, ensuring a rich culinary experience for residents.

Beaches near Wasl Gate

JBR Beach, located approximately 15 minutes from Wasl Gate, offers a range of waterfront activities, including swimming, water sports, and beachfront dining. Marina Beach, approximately 17 minutes away, provides a vibrant atmosphere with scenic views and leisure facilities, making it a popular spot for relaxation and outdoor fun.

Hotels in Wasl Gate

Premier Inn Dubai Ibn Battuta, located about 6 minutes from Wasl Gate, offers modern rooms, a rooftop pool, and a well-equipped fitness center. Avani Ibn Battuta Dubai, approximately 7 minutes away, features contemporary accommodations, multiple dining options, and easy access to shopping destinations. Both hotels provide convenient lodging options for visitors and business travelers.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness, and Beauty

Residents can enjoy outdoor activities such as jogging in landscaped parks, fitness training at premium gyms, and relaxation at local spas and salons. With a focus on wellness and leisure, Wasl Gate ensures a balanced lifestyle with diverse recreational options.

Wasl Gate Attractions and Landmarks

Ibn Battuta Mall, located just 6 minutes from Wasl Gate, is one of the world's largest themed malls, featuring over 400 retail stores, a multi-screen cinema, and a range of dining options. The mall’s unique architecture, inspired by the travels of Ibn Battuta, adds to its charm.

MotionGate Dubai, approximately 19 minutes from Wasl Gate, is a world-class theme park inspired by Hollywood’s biggest film studios. It offers thrilling rides, live entertainment, and immersive attractions based on popular movie franchises, making it a popular destination for families.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms, and Salons

Wasl Gate offers residents access to well-maintained outdoor parks, ideal for jogging, cycling, and family-friendly activities. The community also features modern fitness centers catering to various workout preferences, while salons and beauty centers provide professional grooming services for men and women.

Wasl Gate provides a well-balanced lifestyle with premium amenities, excellent connectivity, and modern residences. While the area is still developing, its strategic location and continuous expansion make it an attractive option for investors and residents seeking a dynamic community in Dubai.

What types of properties are available in Wasl Gate?

Wasl Gate offers studio, one, two, and three-bedroom apartments, as well as three and four-bedroom villas for rent and sale. Retail shops and off-plan units are also available.

Is Wasl Gate a freehold community?

Yes, Wasl Gate is a freehold community, making it an attractive option for both local and international investors looking for properties for sale in Dubai.

What amenities are available in Wasl Gate?

Residents enjoy access to landscaped parks, gyms, retail outlets, Festival Plaza Mall, and dining options within the community.

How well-connected is Wasl Gate to other parts of Dubai?

Located along Sheikh Zayed Road (E11), Wasl Gate offers seamless connectivity to key areas such as Downtown Dubai and Dubai Marina.

Are there schools near Wasl Gate?

Yes, Jebel Ali Primary School, Ghaf Private School, and The Winchester School are nearby, offering British and American curricula.

The residential options in Dubai Academic City are designed to cater to the diverse needs of its residents. From modern apartments to spacious villas, the area provides a variety of housing choices that meet different preferences and budgets.

The area is well-connected to the rest of Dubai through major road networks, ensuring that all the city's attractions and business districts are within easy reach.

nodes.title: Taiyo Residences
nodes.about:
Taiyo Residences by LMD is a refined off-plan development located in the dynamic Wasl Gate community. Developed by LMD Continental Investments, this 14-floor residential project features a range of studio, 1, 2 and 3-bedroom apartments. Taiyo Residences by LMD at Wasl Gate is thoughtfully designed to capture natural light and optimize space, offering elegant interiors and fully fitted kitchens that embody both comfort and functionality.

Taiyo Residences location places residents near Sheikh Zayed Road, ensuring seamless access to key destinations across Dubai. The project is enriched with curated lifestyle amenities including indoor and outdoor gyms, a lap pool, kids pool, BBQ area, paddle court, gaming and billiards zones, co-working spaces, a coffee bar, reading and quiet zones, and family-friendly facilities such as a kids area. This array of offerings creates an environment where recreation, relaxation, and productivity meet in perfect balance.

nodes.title: Sola Residence
nodes.about:
Sola Residence at Wasl Gate is the latest development by Centurion Group, offering studios, 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments in one of Dubai’s most sought-after locations. This masterfully planned community blends modern living with premium amenities, making it an ideal choice for families and investors seeking exceptional real estate opportunities.

Designed for comfort and connectivity, Sola Residence at Wasl Gate Master Plan places residents at the heart of convenience. With Energy Metro Station just a short walk away and seamless access to Sheikh Zayed Road, commuting is effortless. The community features a central park, fitness centers, swimming pools, and children's play areas, ensuring a well-rounded lifestyle. Located along Sheikh Zayed Road, this dynamic development provides direct access to the Energy Metro Station, making commuting effortless. Residents will enjoy proximity to Festival Plaza, IKEA, Dubai Marina, Downtown Dubai, and Business Bay, ensuring everything you need is just minutes away.
